buyer_question: Is the cloud bill surprise from AWS Azure Google Cloud Kubernetes LLM API or GPU usage?
evidence_to_collect: Read-only billing export or screenshot showing service/date/account/project/subscription/workspace without credentials
owner: Finance owner plus cloud engineering owner
redaction_rule: Remove account IDs secrets patient/customer data and payment details
decision_gate: Do not buy a new tool until source categories are separated
claim_boundary: No savings or cost reduction claim

buyer_question: Which teams or products own the top cost drivers?
evidence_to_collect: Tag coverage report owner map cost-center list product map and unresolved shared-cost notes
owner: CTO or platform owner plus product owner
redaction_rule: Use internal labels or pseudonyms where public sharing is possible
decision_gate: Escalate unowned spend before shutdown or commitment decisions

buyer_question: Can native AWS Azure or Google Cloud dashboards answer the question first?
evidence_to_collect: Cost Explorer Azure Cost Management Google Cloud Billing reports budgets anomalies and recommendation screenshots
redaction_rule: Export only non-sensitive summaries no credentials or production logs
decision_gate: Use native evidence before platform demos when single-cloud scope is enough
claim_boundary: No cloud-provider partnership or endorsement claim

buyer_question: Where do FinOps platforms add value beyond native tools?
evidence_to_collect: Comparison of allocation forecasting anomaly Kubernetes unit-economics reporting and workflow needs
owner: Finance systems owner plus FinOps lead
redaction_rule: Redact vendor pricing contract terms and private architecture
decision_gate: Shortlist platform only when multi-cloud or workflow gaps are explicit
claim_boundary: No vendor superiority or ranking claim

buyer_question: What cost action is safe without breaking production?
evidence_to_collect: Rollback plan reliability/security constraint impact owner and approval log
redaction_rule: Do not include secrets incidents or regulated records
decision_gate: Pause changes lacking rollback or reliability evidence
claim_boundary: No uptime reliability or safety claim

buyer_question: What can AICS inspect without credentials?
evidence_to_collect: Redacted billing screenshots CSV exports owner lists tag samples and decision questions
redaction_rule: No credentials no secrets no PHI/ePHI no personal data no production logs
decision_gate: Proceed only with fixed-scope diagnostic boundaries
claim_boundary: No audit compliance certification or ROI claim
